messages:
sam: Quick sync: we've seen recurring windows where aggregator outputs zeroes after ETL lag spikes. Postmortem had action items but ownership got fuzzy. Need a crisp owner map and a small playbook to prevent recurrence.
anya: Agreed. Recent RCA: malformed spans caused trace_id generation to fail -> ETL path dropped null-trace rows before aggregation -> aggregator had divide-by-zero and emitted NaNs/zeros.
ops-bot: incident_alert: observability_aggregate_drop detected at 2024-11-06T11:12:03Z severity=medium lag=14m
matt: Immediate mitigation: add ETL guard that routes malformed spans to overflow stream instead of dropping. I'll open a hotfix PR with feature-flag. ETA ~45m.
rachel: I'll take backfill. Plan: sample top affected product_keys, recompute aggregates from raw events, idempotent upsert into aggregator_canonical with reconciled_by tag.
sam: Proposed owners/timeline: HOT (0-2h) = matt hotfix + flag, SAMPLE (2-6h) = rachel run sampler + post deltas, BACKFILL (6-18h) = rachel run prioritized backfill, MEDIUM (24-72h) = anya merge permanent fix, CI tests, runbook.
anya: I'll add unit tests to assert no NaN propagation and a CI synthetic that injects null-traces to verify ETL overflow path. Also add an alert for "reconciliation_delta_rate" > 0.5% sustained 30m.
matt: Hotfix will coalesce missing trace_id -> gen_uuid() and tag "ingest_fix=v2". Note: this may bump cardinality; notifying analytics. PR: hotfix/agg-guard-347.
rachel: Sam, sampler SQL I'm using: ```sql
SELECT product_key, window_start, sum(raw_count) as raw, sum(coalesce(agg_count,0)) as agg, (sum(raw_count)-sum(coalesce(agg_count,0))) as delta
FROM reconciliation_sampler
WHERE ingestion_time >= now() - interval '48 hours'
GROUP BY product_key, window_start
HAVING abs(sum(raw_count)-sum(coalesce(agg_count,0))) > 5
ORDER BY abs(delta) DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
sam: Good. Add check to mark windows as reconciled and include reconciled_by metadata. We'll want product sign-off on deltas >1%.
anya: Runbook items I'll add: 1) triage checklist, 2) hotfix rollback steps, 3) backfill playbook snippet + idempotency notes, 4) weekly reconciliation audit and owner.
matt: Hotfix opened and deployed to staging at 2024-11-06T11:40:12Z. Requesting reviews.
ops-bot: deploy_event: hotfix/agg-guard-347 promoted to staging at 1765432400
rachel: Sampling results posted: top 25 keys with deltas; most under 0.8% except 4 keys at 2-3%. Prioritizing those for backfill. Backfill ETA start 3h.
sam: Owners final: matt=hotfix+merge, rachel=backfill+validation, anya=permanent fix+CI+runbook, sam=postmortem owner+product comms. I'll update the postmortem doc with due dates and close conditions (weekly reconciliation running clean for 4 weeks).
anya: Also adding an automated CI scenario to run on critical infra merges that simulates late-arriving spans and malformed payloads. Prevents regression.
matt: Will ping analytics with expected cardinality delta sample once backfill sample done.
sam: Thanks team. Check-in in 6 hours or sooner if any step blocks. :white_check_mark:
